## Description

Computes portfolio weights by minimizing expected variance over a Wasserstein ball ambiguity set centered around the empirical return distribution, eliminating estimation error sensitivity.

## Where it may fit

High parameter uncertainty, out-of-sample covariance instability, macro regime transitions.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Funds, Systematic Pension Portfolios.

## Required data

Historical asset return matrices, Wasserstein ball radius ambiguity parameters.

## Caveats

Equivalent robust reformulation leads to semi-definite programming (SDP) problems that scale with asset universe size.
